title: Mandya
desc: Ganesh, also known as Eshwar, is compelled to move to the city after the bloodshed in his native town devastates him. When he returns years later, he adopts the task of educating people.

title: Janumada Jodi
desc: A lovelorn village boy, Krishna, and a girl, Kanaka, cross all barriers of caste and tradition to unite in a meaningful manner.

title: Damayanthi
desc: A young man struggles to pay off his father's debts and decides to visit his family's abandoned bungalow. However, he soon realises that it is haunted by a vengeful ghost.

title: Krishnam Vande Jagadgurum
desc: Babu, an unwilling theatre artist, travels to Bellary to fulfil his grandpa's dying wish. While there, he uncovers the heartbreaking truth about his long-deceased parents and seeks retribution.

title: Sirivantha
desc: Narayana Murthy wages a courageous battle to withstand all pressures and fight against corruption to retain the values he has cherished.
